population.span: We have designed a prospective, parallel group trial where people aged 65 years or more admitted to hospital and receiving one or more antibiotics are randomly allocated to receive either one capsule of the probiotic or a matching placebo daily for 21 days.

endpoint.span: The primary outcomes were occurrence of AAD within 8 weeks and C difficile diarrhoea (CDD) within 12 weeks of recruitment.

estimate.span: AAD (including CDD) occurred in 159 (10·8%) participants in the microbial preparation group and 153 (10·4%) participants in the placebo group (relative risk [RR] 1·04; 95% CI 0·84-1·28; p=0·71).

ci.span: AAD (including CDD) occurred in 159 (10·8%) participants in the microbial preparation group and 153 (10·4%) participants in the placebo group (relative risk [RR] 1·04; 95% CI 0·84-1·28; p=0·71).

treatment_strategy.span: A computer-generated randomisation scheme was used to allocate participants (in a 1:1 ratio) to receive either a multistrain preparation of lactobacilli and bifidobacteria, with a total of 6 × 10(10) organisms, one per day for 21 days, or an identical placebo.

follow_up.span: The primary outcomes were occurrence of AAD within 8 weeks and C difficile diarrhoea (CDD) within 12 weeks of recruitment.

served_mismatch: The served effect and confidence interval match the source, and served_row correctly states modified intention-to-treat. However, served_outcome.population specifies intention-to-treat; the reported analysis is modified intention-to-treat. The AAD timepoint is within 8 weeks of recruitment, more specific than 'study end'.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Hospitalised patients aged 65 years or older receiving antibiotics fall within the question's population of patients receiving antibiotics.
entry_population_matches_question.span: We have designed a prospective, parallel group trial where people aged 65 years or more admitted to hospital and receiving one or more antibiotics are randomly allocated to receive either one capsule of the probiotic or a matching placebo daily for 21 days.

notes: The held full text is the PLACIDE study protocol (PMID 22559011), not the results report. The results abstract supplies the observed effect, confidence interval, actual analysis set and endpoint-specific follow-up; these take precedence over prospective protocol statements.
